map.做年度预算与现金流预测时，将无形资产摊销作为非付现成本单独列示，区分经营现金流入: When preparing the annual budget and cash flow forecast, list intangible asset amortisation separately as a non-cash cost to distinguish operating cash inflow from accounting expenses.

map.年摊销 = (成本 − 残值) / 摊销年限。: Annual amortisation = (cost − residual value) / amortisation period.
map.并购或投资取得可辨认无形资产后，把购买对价中分摊到该资产的部分按期摊销，避免一次: After acquiring an identifiable intangible asset through merger, investment, or purchase, the portion of the consideration allocated to that asset is amortised over time, avoiding one-off expensing that distorts the income statement.
map.持有专利、商标或软件著作权等无形资产时，按直线法在预计使用年限内平均分摊入账成本: When holding intangible assets such as patents, trademarks, or software copyrights, the recorded cost is allocated evenly over the expected useful life using the straight-line method, which makes period profit and loss accounting easier and links up with tax depreciation.
map.按合同权利、法律规定或预期经济利益期限三者孰短确定；使用寿命不确定的无形资产与商: Determined by whichever is shortest of the contractual rights, the legal period, or the expected economic benefit period; intangible assets with an uncertain useful life and goodwill are not amortised but tested for impairment.
map.摊销作为费用在税前扣除，减少应纳税所得额；但税务只认可税法规定的摊销年限与方法，: Amortisation is deducted as an expense before tax, reducing taxable income; but tax only accepts the amortisation period and method set by tax law, which creates a temporary difference with accounting amortisation and requires a tax adjustment.

map.直线法每期摊销额相等，计算简单、利润平滑；加速法（如年数总和法）前期多摊、后期少: The straight-line method has equal amortisation each period and is simple with smooth profit, while an accelerated method (such as the sum-of-years-digits method) amortises more early and less later, matching the declining usefulness of technology assets but depressing early profit.
